backend/main.mo: Main canister actor defining persistent state, authorization mixin usage, admin password, pairing logic, user profiles, schedules, filters, activities, locations, and audit log types.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module initializing new state with an empty allowlisted admin principals set.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing each major frontend component and its functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining light/dark theme CSS variables and applying global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file setting metadata, favicon, manifest, and bootstrapping the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: Web app manifest defining PWA metadata such as name, icons, colors, and categories.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing asset caching and background sync for queued location updates.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication, role-based routing, admin gating, and presence heartbeat.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccountsTa: Empty placeholder file for an admin accounts table component.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPassw: Provides admin password verification and password change UI with allowlist checks, form handling, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/admin/Aggregated: Fetches and displays admin dashboard metrics in a grid of metric cards with icons and loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertsPan: Shows a child's daily usage status, alerts for over-limit usage, and allows children to request more time.
Displays a parent's view of a child’s daily usage with alerts and summary information.
frontend/src/components/audit/AuditLogTa: Fetches and displays a sortable audit log table with action labels, executor info, and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Renders a login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading, error handling, and admin gate resets.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal for initial profile setup including name, role selection, optional phone handling, and allowlist detection.
frontend/src/components/child/ActivityHi: Displays a sortable table of a child’s activity history fetched via queries, with optional transparency label.
frontend/src/components/child/ChildCheck: Provides UI for children to submit activities, share manual or live location, and manage sharing settings.
frontend/src/components/child/ConsentNot: Shows a consent alert with icon and text based on activity, location, or pairing context.
frontend/src/components/child/LocationHi: Displays a filtered, sortable table of a child’s location history with map links and optional transparency label.
frontend/src/components/child/PairWithPa: Handles child-parent pairing via code or phone verification with validation, status polling, and success feedback.
frontend/src/components/filters/ContentF: Allows parents to view and edit a child’s content filter categories, allowlist, and blocklist.
Shows a read-only view of the child’s configured content filter, including categories and lists.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSel: Dropdown allowing users to switch app language between English and Portuguese using i18n hooks.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Footer displaying app copyright, transparency policy link, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Header showing app logo, user info with role, theme toggle, language selector, and login button.
frontend/src/components/parent/ActivityV: Shows a consent notice and a live-updating activity history list for a selected child.
frontend/src/components/parent/ChildSumm: Card summarizing a child's recent activity and location counts with selectable highlighting.
frontend/src/components/parent/LiveLocat: Displays latest child location, freshness indicators, live-sharing status, and fallback states.
frontend/src/components/parent/LocationV: Tabbed interface showing a child's live location map and historical location list with a consent notice.
frontend/src/components/parent/PairingSe: Generates and displays a pairing code with warnings and copy functionality for parent‑child linking.
frontend/src/components/parent/ParentPho: Manages viewing and editing a parent's phone number with validation and profile saving.
frontend/src/components/schedule/Schedul: Editable schedule UI that loads a child's schedule, lets parents adjust daily limits and time windows, and saves updates via mutation hooks.
Read-only view showing a child's configured daily screen-time limit and allowed time windows.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGate.ts: Simple sessionStorage-based gate that marks whether an admin verification step has been passed.
frontend/src/hooks/useI18n.ts: Thin wrapper returning the i18n context for translations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login/logout handlers, and persistent identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveLocationSharin: Periodic geolocation capture hook that submits updates, queues failures, and retries with background sync when possible.
Sends periodic heartbeats to the backend when authenticated and also triggers on visibility changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend calls for profiles, admin checks, relationships, activities, schedules, and more.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: Provides an i18n context with language state, persistence, and a translation function with parameter replacement.
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Exports locale types, supported locales, and translation maps for English and Portuguese.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/en.ts: Contains the full set of English UI translation strings for the app.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/pt-BR.ts: Contains the full set of Brazilian Portuguese UI translation strings for the app.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and custom CSS variables for light and dark navy-themed color palettes.
frontend/src/lib/leafletMarkerIcon.ts: Empty placeholder file for Leaflet marker icon logic.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Displays the admin dashboard with metrics, descriptions, and placeholder management tabs.
frontend/src/pages/child/ChildHome.tsx: Shows a child's home dashboard with pairing status, activity/location history, schedule, filters, and alerts.
frontend/src/pages/parent/ParentDashboar: Parent dashboard UI showing child info, pairing requests, activity, location, schedules, filters, alerts, and account setup components.
Renders a modal showing transparency and data policy sections using translated text.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Registers the service worker and exposes helpers for background sync, periodic sync, and retrieving the registration.
frontend/src/utils/liveLocationCapabilit: Detects device capabilities for geolocation, service workers, background sync, and provides user-facing capability messages.
frontend/src/utils/locationUpdateQueue.t: Implements a localStorage-backed queue for geolocation updates with retry handling and size limits.
frontend/src/utils/phoneNumber.ts: Provides utilities for normalizing, validating, formatting, and comparing phone numbers in a fixed 11‑digit format.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading URL params, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, typography, animations, and project‑specific theme extensions.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature requirements, admin‑role rules, and dashboard metric specifications.
